title: Soak: repeated movement and combat cycles, leak and drift checks
description: Default 300 s; pass --duration for a longer soak. Memory slope of the server container, entity-count drift, accumulated errors and render jumps over the whole run. The 300 s movement and combat cycle repeats for the whole duration (repeat_cycle_s), so a run with --duration 3600 stays active for the hour. Soaks recorded before version 4 (20261022T112220Z-S09-eeoa, 20261022T163744Z-S09-sfj5, 20261022T175111Z-S09-y6vg) ran the cycle once: 5 minutes active, then 55 minutes of idle players. Version 5 adds requires_clean_host: the run refuses to start on a failed host preflight and the host guard grades INVALID when AnyDesk session, foreign build or a blind guard touches the window (no threshold or pass rule changed).

assertions.title: received world ticks never go backwards or repeat within a session
local prediction hard snaps per client-minute
live enemies never exceed the server's hard budget
removed entities leave the screen; reused ids start at their spawn (C3)
clients draw a remote entity in the same place at the same render tick (C4)
